canonicalSource.name: Star Wars: Unlimited official card database

sets.name: Legacy of the Force — Weekly Play

notes: Treatments (Hyperspace, Showcase, etc.) are not identifier fields — the canonical source already assigns each a distinct collectorNumber, so they're captured implicitly. Treatment names are display metadata only, never matched on.

printedTotal is present on mainline cards in every set, and on SOR/SHD/TWI-era weekly-play promos (which share their mainline set's code and need the total to disambiguate from it, e.g. '07/20' vs '07/262'). It is absent on JTLP/LOFP/SECP/LAWP-style weekly-play promos, which have their own dedicated set code and no longer need a total to disambiguate.

'-P' weekly-play set names above ('Jump to Lightspeed — Weekly Play', etc.) are descriptive placeholders, not verified official branding — confirm against canonicalSource before treating them as authoritative.

finish is always present, even on sets where a foil printing shares its collectorNumber with the non-foil version (SOR/SHD/TWI) rather than having its own distinct number (later sets) — kept uniform so no implementer needs to know per-set which numbering rule applies.
knownCollisions is intentionally empty. No verified real collision is currently known for this game; see SPEC.md 4.5 for the shape to use if/when one is found.
